The answer is **Unión**, not Madrid: Real Unión de Irún, from Irun in Gipuzkoa, was a founding member of La Liga in 1929 and is known for its white-and-black kit. My earlier answer was wrong because I went with the Real Madrid story and never confirmed the kit clue. This rests on the team note plus my own recall, which I have not checked against a source here.

CONFIDENCE: 85
